data.current_description: Upload one resume file and receive the structured candidate profile in the same response.
data.summary_suggestion: Extract structured candidate profile from resume file
data.description_suggestion: Upload a resume file (PDF, DOC, DOCX, ODT, PPT, PPTX, ODP, XLS, RTF, TXT, JPG, PNG, BMP) to extract a structured candidate profile. Synchronous by default (35-145 seconds); supports asynchronous mode via `Prefer: respond-async` header with webhook callback. Scanned documents are OCR'd on first 4 pages; up to 100,000 characters extracted. Returns 200 with full profile or 200 with `upstream_status: "partial"` if optional steps are skipped. Costs 1 credit on success; failed requests are not charged. Use client timeout of at least 150 seconds.

data.current_summary: Match a candidate to a job
data.current_description: Evaluate one resume against each job criterion and get an explained 0–1 score.
data.description_suggestion: Evaluate a candidate's resume against each job criterion, returning a weighted 0–1 score with per-criterion explanations. Score formula: `Σ(weight × value) / Σ weight` where ideal=1, potential=0.6, not_mentioned=0.5, not_valid=0. All criteria count in denominator; `is_mandatory` does not affect score—check `is_mandatory` and `match_status` in code to enforce hard requirements. Empty criteria list returns score 0 without calling the model. Synchronous (60-second timeout). Costs 1 credit on success; failed requests are not charged.

data.current_description: Turn free text, from one skill to a whole skills section, into taxonomy skills with their families and domains.
data.description_suggestion: Convert free-text skills (single skill to full section) into taxonomy skills with families and domains.
